output.question: What is Grainger's annual revenue?
output.answer: W.W. Grainger's (NYSE: GWW) most recent full-year revenue is $17.94 billion in net sales for fiscal 2025, up 4.5% from $17.17 billion in 2024. The company reported it on February 3, 2026. For 2026, Grainger raised its full-year net sales guidance on November 4, 2026 to $19.8–20.0 billion, from $19.4–19.7 billion. That would be growth of 10.1%–11.6%. Net sales for the first nine months of 2026 were $14.94 billion, and third-quarter 2026 net sales were $5.18 billion, up 11.3% from a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: FY2025 net sales were $17,942 million (about $17.9B), up 4.5% (4.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis).
Q3 2026 net sales were $5,181 million, up 11.3% from Q3 2025 (14.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis).
Net sales for the first nine months of 2026 were $14,944 million, compared with $13,517 million in the same period of 2025.
FY2026 net sales guidance was raised to $19.8–20.0 billion (10.1%–11.6% growth) from $19.4–19.7 billion.

passages.quote: For the full year, sales of $17.9 billion increased 4.5%, or 4.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis
For the full year 2025, total Company sales increased 4.5% versus the full year of 2024.
Delivered sales of $5.2 billion, up 11.3%, or 14.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis
Sales in the quarter increased 11.3% compared to the third quarter of 2025.

caveats: The latest completed fiscal year is FY2025 ($17.9B). FY2026 results are not out yet (expected around early February 2027), so the 2026 number is guidance of $19.8–20.0B, not actual revenue.

Grainger reports revenue as 'net sales'. The 2026 growth comparisons include the effect of the company's exit from the U.K. market and currency effects, which is why its 'organic constant currency' growth figures run higher than reported growth.
The FY2025 figures were read from an SEC 8-K mirror (last10k.com) rather than directly from sec.gov.
Trailing-twelve-month revenue would be about $19.37B ($17,942M − $13,517M + $14,944M). This is my own calculation and is not stated in any source.
